objective.why: CONVERT ENTRIES, NOT DEATHS. Measured on the champion's own 84-game log set at the pinned harness (2026-10-01): eminence fires 8.04 times a game and 9.64 of our creatures die a game, and the death-drain payoffs trigger 1.90 times — a conversion rate near 20%. Blood Artist is CAST in 17% of games and sits on the battlefield about half a turn per game: the deck has ~4 death payoffs in 99 cards, they are 2-mana creatures, and they die to the same wipes that kill the fodder. Meanwhile the deck declares 5.5 attacks a game across ~10 of its own turns, because 1/1 tokens into three opponents' blockers are never profitable, and its biggest hit is 8.4. THAT is the pilot's 'slower, less scary, runs out of gas' — not a draw problem (1.46 extra cards a turn, 2 in hand) but a CONVERSION problem. WHY THE LAST TWO BRANCHES FAILED THE SAME WAY: both answered it with 4-5 mana payoffs. drain-v1 and boss-v1 each raised drain ~+4.5 and lost ~17 combat damage, taking TOTAL life removed from 59.5 to 47.5 and 47.2 — a 4:1 losing trade that no single old axis could see, which is why forge.life_removed_total was added today. THIS BRANCH converts the 8 entries a game instead, at 2-3 mana, needing no attack step and no blocker maths, and cuts only cards that convert NOTHING — nothing that attacks and no lord, which is the mistake the August go-wide refactor made when it cut every lord and took combat damage 29.07 -> 18.20. Two of the three adds are ENCHANTMENTS, so a creature wipe does not take the payoff with the fodder. Bracket 4 stands (pilot, 2026-10-01); Conqueror and the loop stay, unbuilt-for. Harness PINNED: standard-v3 / ov8c347642 / mm-edgar-vampires (aif7c3b6a8) / tlc22ecaf3 — the champion's 200 games stay the comparison. The line is the champion's total output 59.53 plus the MDE at 200/arm (19.30), rounded: >= 79. Every add is cast-checked before the arm.
